sourceDescription: Starter capability map for an electricity network operator (a distribution network operator taking on distribution system operator functions, or a transmission owner), drafted 2026-09-07 as the worked example of the utility map: the four utility-specific level-1 capabilities (codes 9-12) use exactly the utility map's level-1 wording, and every level-2 under them is electricity-specific rather than a restatement of the generic utility level-2s — except Connections and Emergency Response, which are the same capability and keep the same wording. Drafted from general familiarity with the reference models named in sources.md; nothing is copied verbatim. Pending human review — status stays draft until a named reviewer signs it off. Licence: CC BY 4.0.
